description: This file defines the Review class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling review-related database operations such as adding reviews, retrieving reviews by product ID, and counting total reviews for a product.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: A model class for handling product reviews, including adding new reviews, fetching reviews for a product, and counting total reviews.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Inserts a new review record into the database for a specified product.

methods.name: getReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Returns the total number of reviews for a specific product.
